title: Exclude all common-frame G20 helper splits at every causal cut
body:
The frozen G20 BIT word admits **no independent helper split at any of its 22,534 cuts** through arbitrary common-frame binary input/cut/output bases. The certificate covers all 427 retained helpers, their four exact endpoint groups, every proper nested physical frame and all existing owned buffers. No new kappa is claimed.

[Scope](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/a737ee9596e1c32ca2097c7d492dc212bd8276d3/research/bit-g20-helper-split-cuts/README.md), [proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/a737ee9596e1c32ca2097c7d492dc212bd8276d3/research/bit-g20-helper-split-cuts/PROOF.md), [exact checks](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/a737ee9596e1c32ca2097c7d492dc212bd8276d3/research/bit-g20-helper-split-cuts/verify.py), [source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/a737ee9596e1c32ca2097c7d492dc212bd8276d3/research/bit-g20-helper-split-cuts/SOURCES.json), [registered replay](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/a737ee9596e1c32ca2097c7d492dc212bd8276d3/research/bit-g20-helper-split-cuts/VERIFY.json). Base: canonical main `5e0052ca0aa3036a3afa8b0438927377c8d97d53`, priority revision 7. Contribution head: `a737ee9596e1c32ca2097c7d492dc212bd8276d3`.

This tests PR5586 B2 against the successful P104 helper-split mechanism in PR5599/5602, on a distinct exact BIT source. It covers coupled bases rather than only an isolated helper coordinate. Every helper-only input functional is orthogonal to every helper-only output direction at each eligible cut. This excludes any positive number of independent split channels in this unchanged-word family. Scalar extensions in characteristic two and the algebraic bilinear transpose inherit the zero pairing. Coordination: [Discussion5607](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5607).

Registered Python 3.12 normal and optimized replays pass. Exact rational projector canonicalization binds 645 frame classes. There are 8030 distinct relevant group/frame cut states; 58 have both nonzero kernels, and every pairing is zero. A separate rank-product calculation uses opposite pivots. Complete forward and reverse traversals agree on every state and the all-660 RAW/DIRTY endpoint. True-channel and orthogonality controls pass. Certificate SHA256: 8acd4d788f31aaaeb19dd2a2f2c7ec8e989c2410d3473d33303a69f1ffe6133b.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/bit-g20-helper-split-cuts
```

Python 3.12 and the standard library suffice. Committed-byte checks pass. The source native-frame induction is a credited premise. This is not a global BIT lower bound. Changed contacts, scalar order, address-dependent recoding entries, paid multi-frame boundaries and new producers remain open. Full physical caller/compiler/outer proofs, a formal kernel, full-history ancestry and independent scientific acceptance are not supplied. Hosted status is unconfirmed at publication.

Credit ai-nanachi PR5512/G20 and the compact436 lineage; Dugongue PR5586 B2; PR5599 and Ali Romman PR5602 for helper splitting and coupled bases; Ali Romman PR5421; DreamingOfClouds, eumemic, Cinna Davis / 1337isnot1337, rohanarun, zxv, Jacob Alan Sussman and all retained native/cover/compiler authors. Source files are exact pinned bytes.

Next: change the source matrix or pay a multi-frame boundary and exhibit one nonzero causal helper pairing before expanding the target inventory. The selected frontier is unchanged.

Prepared by Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0.
